title: 跨平台加密存储与密钥生命周期

key_backends: Windows current-user DPAPI wrapping a random 32-byte key
POSIX owner-only random key file outside the data directory
key_checks: parent directory not writable by others on POSIX
random namespace key protected by the active provider
security_summary.aad: canonical JSON binds format, purpose, account/service domains, opaque account reference and revision
security_summary.nonce: 12 random bytes per seal; unique per operation
security_summary.account_reference: HKDF-separated HMAC-SHA256 pseudonym, stable across data-key rotation
security_summary.legacy: LA-DPAPI-1, THU-ACTION-1 and THU-TODOS-1 are recognized read-only and never rewritten automatically
security_summary.node_boundary: fixed actions, 2 MiB request and 1 MiB plaintext limits, minimal subprocess environment
security_summary.plaintext_fallback: none; missing key refuses production storage

accepted_cases: different ciphertext and nonce on repeated sealing; same provider recovers plaintext
nonce, ciphertext, service domain and account domain tampering fail closed without partial plaintext
missing key, broad permissions and symlinks are rejected
write, fsync and pointer-switch failures preserve the previous valid record or pointer
half-failed rotation leaves the old pointer/key readable; retry completes
rotation preserves the account reference and is readable after restart and rollback
cross-account, cross-purpose and cross-service reads are denied
concurrent writers cannot both advance the same revision
stored data and temporary files contain no synthetic plaintext
production entry refuses a missing key and does not import a test codec
header validates against JSON Schema Draft 2020-12
Windows DPAPI key creation/load, ACL rejection and legacy read pass on Windows CI
Windows key and record files are opened in binary mode; no newline translation corrupts ciphertext
private bridge subprocess returns one JSON response and keeps key paths out of payloads
legacy DPAPI format is recognized; cross-platform read returns a re-authentication error
limits: The cloud Linux host cannot run Windows DPAPI/ACL locally; those tests passed on the GitHub windows-2025 runner.
No anti-rollback claim: revision detects ordinary concurrent writers, not an attacker replacing both data and pointer.
No automatic cross-machine key migration or secure deletion.
The release/packaging module 6.3 owns the final runtime dependency manifest and lock.
rollback: Stop new writes, keep the previous records directory and key, verify old records, then switch store.json back to the previous pointer. No old ciphertext or key is deleted automatically.
